scope: Closed, explicitly enumerated 285 normal Codex CLI calls through final verifier heldout. Excludes native authoring, denied Anthropic call and host tools; not a whole campaign total.
time_limits: Call sum includes concurrency; interval union excludes gaps; neither is whole campaign duration.

limits: Retains frozen 2026-09-06 public API rate scenarios, not a newly observed invoice or subscription charge.
Three timed-out calls have unknown usage and cost; no full-batch price or finite upper bound is claimed.
Input contains cache, output contains reasoning; each token counted once.
Context sensitivity applies only to Astra aggregate calls above272K; aggregate is not request-level context evidence.
Standard, no regional uplift/tool surcharge/tax/FX; actual tier and request lengths unknown.
Native lead/agent authoring, tools and ongoing resume-v1 are excluded.
Public 2026-09-06 API rate scenarios, not subscription charges or invoice.
Unknown usage/cost not zero; no finite whole-run upper bound.
Cached input included in input; reasoning included in output, neither counted twice.
Aggregate invocation input is not proof of per-request long context.
Native authoring, host tools, taxes, FX and unobserved tier/region differences excluded.
